experience.title: Dining directly on Lake Garda
experience.text: At Ristorante al Pontile, the lake is part of the experience. Set directly on the shores of Lake Garda in Malcesine, the restaurant offers tables on its private pontile with a privileged view of the medieval Castello di Malcesine, bringing together Italian cuisine, the beauty of the lake and the atmosphere of an unforgettable evening.

moments.title: Moments by Lake Garda
moments.description: A meal by the water, an evening in Malcesine, a toast with friends or simply the view across Lake Garda — moments made memorable at Al Pontile.
moments.footer: Every table has a view. Every moment becomes a memory.

cuisine.title: Italian cuisine by Lake Garda
cuisine.description: At Ristorante al Pontile, Italian tradition meets the flavours of Lake Garda. The menu brings together freshwater fish from the lake, seafood, homemade pasta, selected meats and classic Italian dishes, alongside traditional and gourmet pizzas. From grilled salmon trout and Garda fish pasta to spaghetti allo scoglio, Scottona beef and homemade desserts, the cuisine combines familiar Italian flavours with the character of the lake.
